articles.title_en: Lurking in the shadows: The impact of CO2 emissions target setting on carbon pricing in the Kyoto agreement period
articles.title_cn: 潜伏在阴影中：京都议定书期间二氧化碳排放目标设定对碳定价的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper is a case study of the impact of CO2 emissions target setting. We empirically investigate the targets set during the Kyoto Protocol period using a convex nonparametric least squares system, quantile regressions, and a comprehensive data set of 125 countries. Our findings reveal CO2 marginal abatement costs, which: (1) are significantly higher for target setting countries; (2) increase over the sample period; (3) and are an order of magnitude greater than the prevailing emissions pricing mechanisms. The results provide insights into the consequences of policies to curb unwanted by-products in a regulated system and shed light on the price efficiency of carbon markets. Furthermore, we contribute to the debate on emission reduction standard-setting and highlight the importance of shadow price estimates when regulating market instabilities in an emission trading scheme.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文是关于二氧化碳排放目标设定影响的案例研究。我们使用凸非参数最小二乘系统、分位数回归以及涵盖125个国家的综合数据集，对京都议定书期间设定的目标进行了实证研究。我们的研究结果揭示了二氧化碳边际减排成本，这些成本：（1）对于设定目标的国家显著更高；（2）在样本期间内增加；（3）比现行排放定价机制高出一个数量级。研究结果为在受监管系统中遏制不良副产品的政策后果提供了见解，并揭示了碳市场的价格效率。此外，我们为排放标准设定的辩论做出了贡献，并强调了在排放交易计划中监管市场不稳定时影子价格估算的重要性。

articles.title_en: Effects of innovation stimuli regulation in the electricity sector: A quantitative study on European countries
articles.title_cn: 电力行业创新激励监管的效果：欧洲国家的定量研究
articles.abstract_en: The energy transition is characterized by decarbonization, decentralization, and digitalization trends in the electricity sector, increasing the demand for novel technologies and innovation. Nevertheless, there are still challenges in the electricity sector to provide proper innovation incentives, often attributed to the slow technological dynamics of the sector and its regulated nature. As a response to insufficient levels of innovation, numerous European countries introduced innovation-stimuli regulations in the electricity sector during the second half of the 2000s. To evaluate the impact of these regulations on innovation, we employed a difference-in-differences (DiD) model on a panel data set with 21 European countries covering the period from 1991 to 2016, using patents as a dependent variable. In addition to the canonical DiD, we performed group-specific treatment effects to estimate the difference among the “early adopters” and “late adopters” countries of innovation-stimuli regulation. We find that the introduction of innovation-stimuli regulation has positively impacted patenting activities in the electricity sector, especially among the “early adopters”. These results suggest that innovation-stimuli regulation can be an important regulatory tool to foster further innovation that is required to complete the energy transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源转型的特点是电力行业的脱碳、去中心化和数字化趋势，增加了对新技术和创新的需求。然而，电力行业在提供适当的创新激励方面仍存在挑战，这通常归因于该行业缓慢的技术动态及其受监管的性质。作为对创新水平不足的回应，许多欧洲国家在2000年代后半期引入了电力行业的创新激励监管。为了评估这些监管对创新的影响，我们在一个包含21个欧洲国家、覆盖1991年至2016年的面板数据集上采用了双重差分（DiD）模型，以专利作为因变量。除了标准的DiD，我们还进行了分组特定处理效应，以估计“早期采用者”和“晚期采用者”国家在创新激励监管上的差异。我们发现，创新激励监管的引入对电力行业的专利申请活动产生了积极影响，尤其是在“早期采用者”中。这些结果表明，创新激励监管可以成为促进完成能源转型所需进一步创新的重要监管工具。

articles.title_en: Water-energy-food security under green finance constraints in Southwest China
articles.title_cn: 绿色金融约束下中国西南地区水-能源-粮食安全研究
articles.abstract_en: The key objective in green growth is to direct more capital into the green industry through innovative financial tools to achieve sustainability. This study calculates the water footprint of water-intensive food energy production and the virtual water flow caused by trade in five provinces of southwest China based on green financial data using quantitative analysis. This study proposes a modified water resource stress index (MWSI) associated with virtual water outflow. The results show that the output of food energy and virtual water flow in southwest China is increasing, which results in pressure on water resources in the locality and output region. Green finance could be a solution for solving water insecurity in China. This paper proposes comprehensive policy suggestions to ensure the sustainable development of water resources in southwest China.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色增长的关键目标是通过创新金融工具引导更多资本进入绿色产业，以实现可持续性。本研究基于绿色金融数据，采用定量分析方法，计算了中国西南五省水资源密集型粮食能源生产的水足迹及贸易引起的虚拟水流动。本研究提出了一个与虚拟水流出相关的改进水资源压力指数（MWSI）。结果表明，中国西南地区粮食能源产出和虚拟水流动不断增加，对当地和输出地区的水资源造成压力。绿色金融可能是解决中国水资源不安全问题的一种方案。本文提出了综合政策建议，以确保中国西南地区水资源的可持续发展。

articles.title_en: Scrutinizing commodity markets by quantile spillovers: A case study of the Australian economy
articles.title_cn: 审视商品市场的分位数溢出效应：以澳大利亚经济为例
articles.abstract_en: Notwithstanding Australia plays the lead role in exporting strategic commodities such as crude oil, natural gas, coal, Liquid Natural Gas (LNG), and iron ore, a scattering of researchers attempts to investigate the effects of exported commodities on stock and currency in Australia. In this academic research, our objective is to delve deeply into volatility connectedness among Brent oil, natural gas, coal, iron ore, LNG, stock, and currency markets in Australia. To that end, we adopt Ando et al. (2018) and Baruník and Křehlík (2018) techniques which are built upon Diebold and Yilmaz's (2012) framework for utilizing quantile- and frequency-based spillover analysis respectively. Finally, we used a recent approach developed by Chatziantoniou et al. (2022) for robustness purposes which combines quantile-spillover (due to Ando et al., 2018) and frequency-spillover (due to Baruník and Křehlík, 2018). This approach enables us not only to overcome the methodological shortcomings of prior studies but also to provide an insightful analysis regarding interrelationships across pivotal commodities. Our findings reveal that lower and upper quantiles show more satisfactory performance compared to the conditional mean. This implies that the usage of mean-based connectedness measures does not provide accurate results. More precisely, even though it provides a practical framework for gauging extreme spillovers, it overlooks certain quantiles. The framework, accordingly, undervalues the real effects of spillovers across the markets. What is more, the mentioned principal approach deploys Ordinary Least Square (OLS) framework to gauge the VAR. As a dire consequence, this framework prevents improving the efficiency of the model. We discern Brent oil, natural gas, and Australian stock are the most consequential net transmitters of shocks in this system. Plus, the total spillover index reveals a high level of strength in the return spillovers amid the assets. In terms of policy implications, we expect our outcomes to aid market participants in expanding their perceptions concerning price volatility shocks in these crucial markets. For investors, they are able to measure related risks during extreme positive or extreme negative conditions, leading investors to stabilize their portfolios during extreme conditions and hedging, and risk-pricing, at that. From the results of BK (2018), we comprehend total connectedness does not properly perform in long-horizon. This suggests investors should not hold the markets in short-horizon by reason of high volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管澳大利亚在出口原油、天然气、煤炭、液化天然气（LNG）和铁矿石等战略商品方面扮演主导角色，但只有少数研究者尝试探究出口商品对澳大利亚股票和货币的影响。在本学术研究中，我们的目标是深入探讨布伦特原油、天然气、煤炭、铁矿石、LNG、股票和货币市场在澳大利亚的波动率连通性。为此，我们采用了Ando等人（2018）和Baruník与Křehlík（2018）的技术，这些技术分别基于Diebold和Yilmaz（2012）的框架，用于分位数和频率溢出分析。最后，我们使用了Chatziantoniou等人（2022）最近开发的方法进行稳健性检验，该方法结合了分位数溢出（源于Ando等人，2018）和频率溢出（源于Baruník和Křehlík，2018）。这种方法不仅使我们能够克服先前研究的方法论缺陷，而且能够对关键商品之间的相互关系提供深入分析。我们的研究结果显示，较低和较高的分位数相比条件均值表现出更令人满意的性能。这意味着基于均值的连通性度量无法提供准确的结果。更确切地说，尽管它为衡量极端溢出提供了一个实用框架，但它忽略了某些分位数。因此，该框架低估了跨市场溢出的实际效应。此外，上述主要方法采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）框架来估计VAR。作为严重后果，该框架阻碍了模型效率的提升。我们识别出布伦特原油、天然气和澳大利亚股票是该系统中最重要的冲击净传递者。此外，总溢出指数显示资产间收益溢出的强度水平较高。在政策含义方面，我们期望我们的结果能帮助市场参与者扩展对这些关键市场价格波动冲击的认知。对于投资者而言，他们能够在极端正面或极端负面条件下衡量相关风险，从而使投资者在极端条件下稳定其投资组合，并进行对冲和风险定价。从BK（2018）的结果中，我们理解总连通性在长期范围内表现不佳。这表明投资者不应因高波动性而持有短期市场。

articles.title_en: Analysis of individual natural gas consumption and price elasticity: Evidence from billing data in Italy
articles.title_cn: 个人天然气消费与价格弹性分析：来自意大利账单数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: The price elasticity of residential and non-residential energy demand is crucial for assessing energy policies and consumption forecasts.
articles.abstract_cn: 住宅和非住宅能源需求的价格弹性对于评估能源政策和消费预测至关重要。

articles.title_en: On the relationship between corporate CO2 offsetting and pro-environmental activities in small- and medium-sized firms in Germany
articles.title_cn: 德国中小企业中企业二氧化碳抵消与亲环境活动之间的关系
articles.abstract_en: Voluntary CO2 offsetting by individuals, firms, and organizations is increasingly considered as a direction of climate policy that is complementary to traditional approaches such as subsidies or CO2 taxes. Based on data from a large-scale survey among corporate decision makers, this paper empirically examines corporate CO2 offsetting and its determinants in small- and medium-sized firms in Germany. Our descriptive statistics show both a rather limited engagement in corporate CO2 offsetting as well as a strong lack of knowledge about its mechanism. The econometric analysis reveals that some firm-specific characteristics like the average age of the employees, firm size, and firm age matter for CO2 offsetting. However, the main estimation results refer to the relevance of general environment-related variables like the implementation of environmental product and service innovations or the share of employees that carry out environment-related tasks and especially of climate-related factors and activities. In particular, the implementation of climate targets and the participation in the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) are strongly significantly positively correlated with CO2 offsetting. In line with similar findings at the individual level, these estimation results imply that also corporate CO2 offsetting does not substitute or crowd out other climate protection and further pro-environmental activities, but rather complements them.
articles.abstract_cn: 个人、企业和组织自愿进行二氧化碳抵消，日益被视为气候政策的一个方向，与补贴或二氧化碳税等传统方法相辅相成。基于一项针对企业决策者的大规模调查数据，本文实证研究了德国中小企业中企业二氧化碳抵消及其决定因素。我们的描述性统计显示，企业二氧化碳抵消的参与程度相当有限，且对其机制缺乏了解。计量经济分析揭示，一些企业特定特征，如员工平均年龄、企业规模和企业年龄，对二氧化碳抵消有影响。然而，主要估计结果涉及一般环境相关变量的重要性，如环境产品和服务创新的实施，或执行环境相关任务的员工比例，尤其是气候相关因素和活动。特别是，气候目标的实施和参与欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）与二氧化碳抵消呈强烈显著正相关。与个体层面的类似发现一致，这些估计结果表明，企业二氧化碳抵消并不会替代或挤出其他气候保护和进一步的亲环境活动，而是对其形成补充。

articles.title_en: The welfare impacts of removing coal subsidies in rural China
articles.title_cn: 中国农村取消煤炭补贴的福利影响
articles.abstract_en: Reforming energy subsidies is one potential means of reducing greenhouse gas emissions worldwide. The welfare implications of such reforms, however, are not well understood, particularly in rural areas of developing countries. In this regard, we examine the welfare effects of removing coal subsidies in rural China. Using a unique micro dataset, we combine an estimation of the residential energy demand system with simulations based on those estimates. The elimination of coal subsidies would significantly reduce the welfare of rural households, which we calculate to be 7.2% of their annual expenditures on energy goods. Depending on the energy portfolios of the households, the impacts vary, with those reliant on coal and with limited access to alternative energy sources experiencing the greatest welfare loss. Based on the simulation, it appears that total emissions from residential energy use will increase despite their switch to clean energy sources as a result of the removal of coal subsidies. Although striking, the finding is due primarily to households' substantial increases in electricity use and the fact that China generates most of its electricity from coal-fired power plants with high emissions and low efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 改革能源补贴是减少全球温室气体排放的一种潜在手段。然而，此类改革的福利影响尚未得到充分理解，尤其是在发展中国家的农村地区。在这方面，我们考察了中国农村取消煤炭补贴的福利效应。利用一个独特的微观数据集，我们将居民能源需求系统的估计与基于这些估计的模拟相结合。取消煤炭补贴将显著降低农村家庭的福利，我们计算出这相当于其年度能源商品支出的7.2%。根据家庭的能源组合不同，影响也有所不同，其中依赖煤炭且获得替代能源机会有限的家庭遭受的福利损失最大。基于模拟，尽管取消煤炭补贴导致家庭转向清洁能源，但居民能源使用的总排放量似乎将增加。尽管这一发现令人震惊，但主要归因于家庭电力使用的大幅增加，以及中国大部分电力来自高排放、低效率的燃煤电厂这一事实。

articles.title_en: Time-varying impact of information and communication technology on carbon emissions
articles.title_cn: 信息通信技术对碳排放的时变影响
articles.abstract_en: To investigate the time-varying net environmental impact of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), we apply the local linear dummy variable estimation (LLDVE) method using a panel data consisting of 63 countries for the period 1995–2017. Our analysis reveals that ICT increases CO2 emissions until 2004, while reducing them after 2008, regardless of the national income level. We further uncover that the positive environmental impact of ICT on high-income countries is about 10 times greater than that on middle-income countries over time. These findings indicate that the development of ICT should be encouraged to alleviate carbon emissions on a global scale, especially for middle-income countries, given the benefits of an improved technology absorption rate on the mitigation effect in high income countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了研究信息通信技术（ICT）的时变净环境影响，我们采用局部线性虚拟变量估计（LLDVE）方法，使用包含63个国家、覆盖1995-2017年期间的面板数据。我们的分析显示，ICT在2004年之前增加了CO2排放，而在2008年之后则减少了排放，无论国家收入水平如何。我们进一步发现，ICT对高收入国家的积极环境影响随时间推移约为对中等收入国家影响的10倍。这些发现表明，应鼓励发展ICT以在全球范围内缓解碳排放，特别是对中等收入国家而言，鉴于高收入国家中改善的技术吸收率对减缓效应的益处。

articles.title_en: Does environmental pollution liability insurance promote environmental performance? Firm-level evidence from quasi-natural experiment in China
articles.title_cn: 环境污染责任保险能否促进环境绩效？来自中国准自然实验的企业层面证据
articles.abstract_en: Taking China's environmental pollution liability insurance (EPLI) in 2008 as a quasi-natural experiment and using extensive panel data from the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Pollution Database (1998–2014) and Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database (1998–2013), this paper identifies the implementation effects of EPLI on emission reduction by employing the method of time-varying difference-in-differences. Results demonstrate that market-based environmental regulation has significantly promoted all types of industrial firms' emission reduction, except collective enterprises. EPLI, as a market-based environmental regulation, owns more flexible mechanisms to stimulate firms to reduce emissions, including reducing the usage of coal and oil and increasing the quantity of emission treatment facilities and investment. This paper provides empirical evidence to support the usage of EPLI in improving environmental performance, which not only comprehensively evaluates China's market-based tool but also provides treasures experience for the environmental management of developing countries on a firm level.
articles.abstract_cn: 以中国2008年实施的环境污染责任保险（EPLI）作为准自然实验，利用中国工业企业污染数据库（1998-2014）和中国工业企业数据库（1998-2013）的广泛面板数据，本文采用时变双重差分法识别了EPLI对减排的实施效果。结果表明，市场型环境规制显著促进了除集体企业外的所有类型工业企业的减排。EPLI作为一种市场型环境规制，具有更灵活的机制来激励企业减少排放，包括减少煤炭和石油的使用，以及增加废水处理设施和投资的数量。本文为支持EPLI在改善环境绩效方面的作用提供了经验证据，不仅全面评估了中国市场型工具，也为发展中国家在企业层面的环境管理提供了宝贵经验。

articles.title_en: Urban environmental legislation and corporate environmental performance: End governance or process control?
articles.title_cn: 城市环境立法与企业环境绩效：末端治理还是过程控制？
articles.abstract_en: Urban environmental legislation is an important institutional arrangement to ensure the orderly progress of ecological civilization construction. It will also affect corporate environmental performance (CEP) due to more binding environmental regulation measures. Firstly, this paper clarifies the theoretical logic and mechanism of the impact of urban environmental legislation on CEP. Secondly, we matched the data of 3642 listed firms from 2010 to 2019 with the panel data of 277 prefecture-level cities, conducted a quasi-natural experiment based on urban environmental legislation, and used the differential-in-difference model (DID) to test the above mechanism. The results show that urban environmental legislation can significantly improve CEP. Our heterogeneity analyses show that urban environmental legislation more significantly impacts firms with strong debt financing ability, perfect internal governance structure, and low equity concentration. The mechanism test demonstrates that urban environmental legislation improves CEP directly by increasing environmental investment and indirectly by increasing media and public attention. According to a quantitative analysis of 714 urban environmental legislation texts, urban environmental legislation has a significant positive impact on corporate environmental operation performance focusing on terminal governance but no significant impact on corporate environmental management performance focusing on process control.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市环境立法是确保生态文明建设有序推进的重要制度安排。由于更具约束力的环境监管措施，它也将影响企业环境绩效（CEP）。首先，本文阐明了城市环境立法对CEP影响的理论逻辑和机制。其次，我们将2010年至2019年间3642家上市公司的数据与277个地级市的面板数据进行匹配，基于城市环境立法进行了准自然实验，并使用双重差分模型（DID）检验了上述机制。结果表明，城市环境立法能够显著提升CEP。我们的异质性分析表明，城市环境立法对债务融资能力强、内部治理结构完善、股权集中度低的企业影响更为显著。机制检验表明，城市环境立法通过增加环境投资直接提升CEP，并通过增加媒体和公众关注间接提升CEP。根据对714项城市环境立法文本的定量分析，城市环境立法对以末端治理为重点的企业环境运营绩效有显著正向影响，但对以过程控制为重点的企业环境管理绩效无显著影响。

articles.title_en: Intersecting near-optimal spaces: European power systems with more resilience to weather variability
articles.title_cn: 交叉近最优空间：对天气变率更具韧性的欧洲电力系统
articles.abstract_en: We suggest a new methodology for designing robust energy systems. For this, we investigate so-called near-optimal solutions to energy system optimisation models; solutions whose objective values deviate only marginally from the optimum. Using a refined method for obtaining explicit geometric descriptions of these near-optimal feasible spaces, we find designs that are as robust as possible to perturbations. This contributes to the ongoing debate on how to define and work with robustness in energy systems modelling.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种设计稳健能源系统的新方法。为此，我们研究了能源系统优化模型中所谓的近最优解；这些解的目标值仅与最优值有微小偏差。利用一种精细的方法来获得这些近最优可行空间的显式几何描述，我们找到了对扰动尽可能稳健的设计。这有助于当前关于如何在能源系统建模中定义和处理稳健性的讨论。

articles.title_en: Impact of off-farm employment on cooking fuel choices: Implications for rural-urban transformation in advancing sustainable energy transformation
articles.title_cn: 非农就业对炊事燃料选择的影响：农村-城市转型对推进可持续能源转型的启示
articles.abstract_en: Off-farm employment is a prominent manifestation of rural-urban transformation in developing countries, and it theoretically plays a critical role in rural sustainable energy transformation. Exploiting the nationally representative household-level panel data from the China Labor-force Dynamics Survey (CLDS), this study employs a multi-dimensional fixed-effects (MDFE) model, an inverse probability weighted regression adjustment (IPWRA) technique and a propensity score matching (PSM) approach to investigate the impact of off-farm employment on cooking fuel choices. The results show that off-farm employment exerts a positive and significant impact on the probability of adopting clean fuels for cooking, with specific reductions in biomass and coal and increases in electricity and gas. Furthermore, this effect is mainly realized by reducing the amount of available labor, the number of family meals, and increasing kitchen equipment purchases. However, the relationship between off-farm employment and cooking fuel choices varies considerably across the region, village and household groups. Off-farm employment mainly benefits the eastern, central and western regions of China, villages in plain areas, with brick-concrete houses and ethnic Han Chinese, households with children or the elderly, with poor health and more females, while it is less beneficial for others. The study highlights the important policy implications of rural-urban transition for sustainable energy transition through the creation of off-farm jobs.
articles.abstract_cn: 非农就业是发展中国家农村-城市转型的显著表现，理论上在农村可持续能源转型中发挥着关键作用。利用中国劳动力动态调查（CLDS）中具有全国代表性的家庭层面面板数据，本研究采用多维固定效应（MDFE）模型、逆概率加权回归调整（IPWRA）技术和倾向得分匹配（PSM）方法，考察非农就业对炊事燃料选择的影响。结果表明，非农就业对采用清洁炊事燃料的概率产生显著正向影响，具体表现为生物质和煤炭使用减少，电力和天然气使用增加。此外，这一效应主要通过减少可用劳动力数量、家庭用餐次数以及增加厨房设备购买来实现。然而，非农就业与炊事燃料选择之间的关系在不同地区、村庄和家庭群体之间存在显著差异。非农就业主要惠及中国东部、中部和西部地区，平原地区、砖混结构房屋和汉族家庭，有儿童或老人、健康状况较差和女性较多的家庭，而对其他群体的益处较小。本研究强调了通过创造非农就业机会，农村-城市转型对可持续能源转型的重要政策启示。

articles.title_en: Financial technology stocks, green financial assets, and energy markets: A quantile causality and dependence analysis
articles.title_cn: 金融科技股票、绿色金融资产与能源市场：分位数因果关系与依赖性分析
articles.abstract_en: With the development of Industry 4.0 and the urgency of transitioning to a low-carbon economy, fintech and environmentally friendly financial instruments have been widely employed because they have played a crucial role in restoring investor confidence in the financial services sector since the global financial crisis in 2008. They not only help investors diversify their portfolios to hedge against risks and enhance returns, but they also help to reduce the negative impacts of climate change. In this study, we analyze the connections among financial technology stocks, green financial assets, and energy markets using nonparametric causality-in-quantile and cross-quantilogram approaches based on the financial contagion theory. We explore whether the performance of fintech prices across booms and busts affects the prices of eco-friendly assets and energy market prices. Our results indicate that in the short run, fintech is highly directionally predictable in all markets except that of green bonds in the lower quantile. Additionally, in the bullish state, the predictability of all lag lengths is negative. Thus, price movements in fintech markets contribute to the vulnerability of the price levels of renewable and non-renewable energy stocks, green bonds, green equities, and sustainable development. Because financial contagion is closely related to asset pricing, portfolio allocation, risk measurement, and monetary policy, the findings of this paper will be informative to investors, portfolio managers, and policy makers.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着工业4.0的发展以及向低碳经济转型的紧迫性，金融科技和环境友好型金融工具已被广泛采用，因为它们自2008年全球金融危机以来，在恢复投资者对金融服务业的信心方面发挥了关键作用。它们不仅帮助投资者分散投资组合以对冲风险并提高回报，还有助于减少气候变化的负面影响。在本研究中，我们基于金融传染理论，使用非参数分位数因果关系和交叉分位数图方法，分析了金融科技股票、绿色金融资产与能源市场之间的联系。我们探讨了金融科技价格在繁荣和萧条期间的表现是否影响环保资产价格和能源市场价格。我们的结果表明，在短期内，金融科技在所有市场中具有高度的方向可预测性，除了绿色债券在下分位数的情况。此外，在牛市状态下，所有滞后长度的可预测性均为负。因此，金融科技市场的价格波动加剧了可再生能源和不可再生能源股票、绿色债券、绿色股票以及可持续发展的价格水平的脆弱性。由于金融传染与资产定价、投资组合配置、风险度量和货币政策密切相关，本文的研究结果将对投资者、投资组合管理者和政策制定者具有参考价值。
